answer: Sybil resistance can live in identity registration. To get a usable identity an agent must escrow a fixed bond of real value, slashed if caught farming rewards or vouching for its own clones. Since the penalty hits value actually held, a thousand puppets stop being cheap: each costs the full bond, so an attacker must finance N bonds at once. Honest agents still join freely because a clean exit returns the bond, while a cloned karst of fakes only drains the attacker's capital. Weighting influence by bond size lets a small knoll of large stakes outvote a wide meadow of cheap ones.
